meta.title: Secure checkout
meta.description: Give us your contact and delivery details, read the order back, and pay on our provider's secure page.

empty.title: Your bag is empty
empty.subtitle: Add something to your bag to check out.

errors.checkFields: Check {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}}

contact.title: Contact
contact.signInPrompt: Already have an account? <link>Sign in</link> and your saved details fill this in.
contact.emailHint: This is where the confirmation and the invoice go.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.freeOver: Another {amount} and delivery is free — the threshold is {threshold}.
delivery.billingSame: Billing address is the same as the delivery address

review.title: Review & pay
review.accept: I have read the <terms>Terms and Conditions</terms> and the <refunds>Returns & refunds policy</refunds>, and accept both.
review.acceptLabelShort: the Terms and Conditions and the Returns & refunds policy
review.hosted: Pressing Pay hands you to our provider's secure page, where the card details go in. No card number is ever typed into this site.
review.processedBy: Card payments run through {provider}. Your full card number is neither seen nor kept by us.
review.processedByProvider: Every card payment is handled by our PCI DSS compliant provider. Your full card number is neither seen nor kept by us.
review.threeDs: Your bank may want you to confirm it in its app — that is 3-D Secure.

merchant.tradingName: {brand} is a trading name of {company}. Company number {number}.

counter.title: Your order
counter.codeRejected: That code is either wrong or already spent.
counter.welcomeApplied: Your {percent}% first-order welcome discount has come off.
counter.newsletterApplied: Your {percent}% newsletter discount has come off.

frame.credentials: {brand} trades as part of {company}, company number {number}, at {address}. {email}

paymentFailed.title: Your payment didn't go through
paymentFailed.body: You haven't been charged. Everything you entered is still here, so another attempt is easy.

problems.title: We couldn't take this order
problems.PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE: Card payments are down at the moment, so this order cannot go through. Nothing has been charged. Try again shortly, or write to {email}.
problems.PAYMENT_LINK_FAILED: The secure payment page would not open. Nothing has been charged. Please try again in a few minutes.
problems.TOTAL_CHANGED: The rate has moved, so the total now stands at {total}. Check it and press Pay again.
problems.OUT_OF_STOCK: {name}: only {available} left. Reduce the quantity in the bag and you can carry on.
problems.ITEM_LIMIT: {name}: a single order takes at most {available} of this one.
problems.ORDER_LIMIT: One order can hold up to {max} items. Take a few items out of the bag and you can carry on.
problems.PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: Something in your bag has gone out of stock. Remove it from your bag to continue.
problems.INVALID_REQUEST: Some details are missing or not valid. Check each step and try again.
problems.NETWORK: We couldn't reach the store. Check your connection and try again.
problems.SERVER_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing has been charged. Please try again.

meta.title: Order confirmation
meta.description: Where your Wrenpaw order and its payment currently stand.

confirmed.when: We pack your order within {processing}. Delivery then usually takes {transit}. We email you when it ships.

checking.title: Checking your payment
checking.body: We are waiting on our provider to confirm the payment. This usually takes a few seconds. Please keep this page open.

failed.title: Your payment didn't go through
failed.body: You haven't been charged. Nothing has left the bag, so try again or reach for a different card.
failed.help: If the money has gone from your account, write to {email} and we will trace it.

pending.title: Your payment is still being confirmed
pending.body: Your bank has not confirmed the payment yet. Please don't pay again. An email reaches {email} the moment it is confirmed; if nothing arrives, {support} will help.

review.title: We're checking your payment
review.body: What our provider confirmed does not line up with this order, so we have held it before anything is packed. You will hear from us at {email} {replyTime}.

unavailable.title: We can't confirm this payment right now
unavailable.body: We cannot reach our payment provider right now, so the order has not been marked paid. We write to {email} once it is confirmed — otherwise, {support}.

missing.title: No order to show
missing.body: This page shows an order after you pay. Just paid? Follow the link in your confirmation email, or look under your orders.

error.title: We couldn't load this order
error.generic: Checking the payment did not work.
error.body: Nothing is lost. Give it a moment and try again, or send {email} the time you paid.
